# MCP tools (`blazma-mcp`)

The MCP server exposes one tool per registry command plus a few session tools. Tool names are the command id with `.` replaced by `_` (`key.set` becomes `key_set`). Each result is the `CommandResult` as pretty JSON text (`ok`, `data`, `transactionId`, `warnings`, `error`); when `ok` is false the tool result has `isError = true`.

Effects: **readonly** runs immediately; **mutating** changes the project and can be undone; **destructive** needs the user's approval in the app (in headless mode it runs directly); **external** reads or writes files outside the project and needs approval unless the path is in an allowed folder.

## Session tools

| Tool | Where | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project_info` | both | Name, file path and unsaved-changes flag of the open project. Call this first. Effect: readonly. |
| `project_save` | both | Save the project to its file (atomic, with read-back check), or to 'path' (save as). Effect: external (writes a file). |
| `task_begin` | both | Start a named task. All edits until task_finish are grouped, shown to the user as one unit and can be approved or rejected together. Effect: session. |
| `task_finish` | both | End the current task. In the app's Assisted mode the user then reviews it (Approve/Reject). Effect: session. |
| `task_status` | both | Your recent tasks with their state (running, review, approved, rejected) and the number of pending approvals. Effect: readonly. |
| `edit_undo` | both | Undo one of your own changes. Only the most recent change on the undo stack can be undone, by passing the transactionId its tool call returned. Effect: mutating. |
| `project_new` | headless only | Headless only: create a new .blazanim project containing the default mannequin character, save it and open it. Fails if the file exists. Effect: external (creates a file). |
| `project_open` | headless only | Headless only: open an existing .blazanim project (takes its session lock; fails if another process has it open). Effect: external (reads a file). |
| `project_close` | headless only | Headless only: close the open project and release its lock. Effect: session. |

### `project_info`

No arguments.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | no | Optional new file path (.blazanim). |

No arguments.

|---|---|---|---|

| `name` | string | no | Project name (default: file name). |
| `discard` | boolean | no | Discard unsaved changes of the currently open project. |

### `project_open`

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of the project file. |
| `discard` | boolean | no | Discard unsaved changes of the currently open project. |

### `project_close`

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `discard` | boolean | no | Discard unsaved changes. |

### `anim_evaluate`

The pose a clip produces at a frame (does not change anything). Returns per-bone rotation/position and the pose JSON.

Effect: **readonly**. Command id: `anim.evaluate`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Frame (may be fractional). |

### `anim_pose_from_frame`

Set the character's working pose to what the clip gives at a frame (undoable).

Effect: **mutating**. Command id: `anim.pose_from_frame`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Frame. |

### `animation_export`

Export a clip as a .glb animation (glTF 2.0 binary) plus a '<name>.blazma.json' sidecar (fps, loop, markers, events, root motion, bone map). The built-in mannequin gets a new file with a simple mesh; an imported character's original file is kept and the animation is appended. Writes files outside the project (the project itself is not changed); agents may only create new files. The written file is re-read and validated.

Effect: **readonly**. Command id: `animation.export`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character to export with (default: the first character using the clip's rig). (min length 1) |
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute path of the .glb to create; its folder must exist. (min length 1) |
| `rootMotion` | string | no | keep (default) \| in_place (remove the root's horizontal X/Z travel, keep height) \| in_place_all (remove all root translation). (min length 1) |
| `startFrame` | integer | no | First frame to export (default 0); it becomes time 0 in the file. (min 0) |
| `endFrame` | integer | no | Last frame to export, inclusive (default: clip length). (min 0) |
| `sidecar` | boolean | no | Also write '<name>.blazma.json' next to the .glb (default true). |
| `overwrite` | boolean | no | Replace existing files (default false). Ignored for agents, which can only create new files. |

### `animation_validate`

Re-read an exported .glb and compare it with the clip frame by frame (position 1e-4 m, rotation 0.01°, scale 1e-4) and check its glTF structure, hierarchy and duration. Returns ok, max errors and issues.

Effect: **readonly**. Command id: `animation.validate`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute path of the .glb. (min length 1) |
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character the file was exported with (default: as for animation.export). (min length 1) |

### `key_set`

Record the character's current pose as keys at a frame (replaces existing keys there). By default every bone and IK control; pass 'bones' to key only some. Binds the clip to the character's rig on first use.

Effect: **mutating**. Command id: `key.set`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | yes | Character id. (min length 1) |
| `frame` | number | yes | Frame number (≥ 0). |
| `bones` | string | no | Comma-separated bone/control names or ids; omit for all. (min length 1) |
| `interpolation` | string | no | step \| linear \| cubic (default cubic for new keys). (min length 1) |

|---|---|---|---|

| `component` | integer | yes | Component index (0-based). |

| `outSlope` | number | no | Outgoing slope (value/second). |

### `rig_import`

Import a rigged character from a .glb/.gltf file. The file is embedded in the project. Returns characterId, rigId and the bone-mapping report.

Effect: **external**. Command id: `rig.import`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute path of the .glb or .gltf file. (min length 1) |
| `name` | string | no | Character name (default: file name). (min length 1) |

### `rig_inspect`

List a rig's bones (name, parent, standard name, rest), controls and IK chains.

Effect: **readonly**. Command id: `rig.inspect`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rigId` | string | no | Rig id (or use characterId). (min length 1) |
| `characterId` | string | no | Character whose rig to inspect. (min length 1) |

### `rig_map_bone`

Correct the humanoid mapping: give a bone a Blazma standard name (e.g. thigh_l), or omit 'standard' to unmap it. IK chains are rebuilt.

Effect: **mutating**. Command id: `rig.map_bone`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rigId` | string | yes | Rig id. (min length 1) |
| `bone` | string | yes | Bone id or name. (min length 1) |
| `standard` | string | no | Standard bone name; omit to unmap. (min length 1) |

### `rig_mapping_report`

Bone-mapping report for a rig: assignments, missing bones and issues.

Effect: **readonly**. Command id: `rig.mapping_report`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rigId` | string | yes | Rig id. (min length 1) |

### `scene_add_mannequin`

Add the built-in humanoid mannequin to the scene. Returns characterId.

Effect: **mutating**. Command id: `scene.add_mannequin`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | no | Character name (default 'Mannequin'). (min length 1) |

### `track_set_flags`

Lock/unlock and/or mute/unmute a track (at least one flag).

Effect: **mutating**. Command id: `track.set_flags`.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | string | yes | Clip id. (min length 1) |
| `trackId` | string | yes | Track id. (min length 1) |
| `locked` | boolean | no | Locked tracks cannot be edited. |
| `muted` | boolean | no | Muted tracks are not evaluated. |
